court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Ltd. and Another .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. S. Dhayalan, Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to call for the records pertaining to the Impugned Order of the second respondent in his proceedings A1/10787/13 dated 30.12.2013 and quash the same illegal and consequently direct the second respondent to include the petitioner name in the Post of Assessor Grade-II (TNEB) Seniority List.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the writ petitioner made a submission that the writ petitioner is now over aged. It is pertinent to note that even at the time of filing of the writ petition, the petitioner was aged about 39 years and now, he would be around 44 years. This apart, the claim of the writ petitioner is for appointment to the post of Assessor and the same cannot be considered without following the recruitment rules in force.

2. Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
